line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.0.4: SSOT for support and research.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Display number of terraformed planets in outpost menu.
* Mordan9 - Show if we have a Jump Station, because we won't be able to tell below. All that will show is Disabled if we are maxed out.
* Add-Ons 2.0.1: Show if we have a Jump Hole Generator. Since 2.0, there are now indicators in the perk UI, but we show the name anyway so the player can cycle through Outposts.
* This perk must be first because Jump Station is a prerequisite to JHG.
* Handle pop growth here. (Add-Ons 1.9.7: Added population assembly perk. 1.14: GetNaturalGrowth now returns an array containing growth, max natural growth, and percentage.)
* Note: OCV playthroughs prevent pop growth.
* Cycle time is 10 minutes by default.
* Use the original projected growth, matching the Outpost task.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Clean up this tooltip for both sides. (1.14: New tooltip depending on reserved pops.)
* Add-Ons 1.9.5: If this Outpost has Industrial overdrive, then growth will always be 0.

line.text: ' Energy Cells at each consumption cycle.'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.2: Add rare terraforming material effects as well. All base amounts for these materials are 0.

line.text: ' Teladianium from local planets at each consumption cycle.'
' Rastar Oil from local planets at each consumption cycle.'

line.comment: * *** Add-Ons 2.1: Molten Worlds also improves Ore and Silicon production ***
* Molten Worlds: +30 Ore and +30 Silicon per minute.

line.text: ' Ore from local planets at each consumption cycle.'
' Silicon from local planets at each consumption cycle.'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.1.1: Tomb Worlds salvage all 4 shipbuilding materials every 3 consumption cycles.

line.text: 'This Outpost receives salvage from Tomb Worlds every 3 consumption cycles.'

line.comment: * ZH 2.0 - Outposts dont need the perk to collect taxes.
* Expanded 2.2: Symmetric convergence in both directions.

line.text: 'No tax income: sector tax efficiency target is 0%.'
'No tax income yet. Tax efficiency is developing.'

* Add-Ons 2.2: Multiplier now handles the multiplier's numerator, so division by 100 must be handled here.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Don't mention maintenance in OCV playthroughs.
